comparison_summary: Unchanged public mounted execution closes at exactly zero allocations after fixing three real allocation sources.
The focused milestone filter grew from 5 to 41 executed checks because Phases 4 through 7 now carry mechanical closure under the same milestone name.
Hostile certification increased 10.9 percent while retaining seven targets and adding real lifecycle, adapter, allocation, and scale evidence.
The original shared-cache timings are retained as historical records but are not used to claim speed improvement.

The holistic-QA paired run found cold workspace check improvement, flat warm platform check, a 15.2 percent warm-fast regression, and a 34.8 percent compile-contract regression while compiler cases grew 45.8 percent and Cargo sessions remained at two.
The repository retains nine integration targets, 23 fail targets, 12 pass targets, two compile-contract Cargo sessions, and zero failed retries.
